research_scope: Ripple-labelled wallet, AMM/vault/loan-broker and Binance-labelled account relationships
Source quality, provenance and archive-validator remediation

market_observations.caveat: Bithomp labels rJqi as Ripple; label is not beneficial-ownership proof.
raRVLN is classified by XRPLWin as AMM pool, vault and loan broker; pool pair and legal owner unknown.
All six deposits predate the separate 20M receipt at 20:16; no sale or proprietary Binance purchase is established.
Dynamic page balances are not synchronized ledger snapshots. RLUSD figures are visible-row lower bounds from a partial page.

findings.statement: Bithomp now displays the 35M XRP payment from rJqi to raRVLN at 20:07 UTC with hash 6EB9F228D2D58631A047D2D8AD003538CD81D7E056028DDD48B809B23B7AD9C7, corroborating the earlier TrackWhale detail.

Bithomp displays six XRP payments from r39TA to Binance-labelled rNxp4h, destination tag 499932645, totaling 68,924,571.602513 XRP. This is an exchange deposit, not proof of sale or Binance-owned inventory.
Bithomp displays a separate 20M XRP payment from raRVLN to r39TA at 20:16 UTC, after the six Binance deposits.
XRPLWin classifies raRVLN as an AMM pool and says it belongs to a vault and a loan broker. Pair, vault identity, loan broker identity and actual collateral use remain unresolved.
Bithomp's r39TA overview shows 5.9M XRP while the earlier 20:40 snapshot showed 25.9M and transaction history still shows a 20M receipt at 20:16. No missing outgoing transfer is inferred.
Bithomp labels rNxp4h as Binance and shows activation by rDAE53 in January 2023. This predates the incident and does not show rNxp4h was compromised.

hypotheses.claim: Ripple treasury or institutional settlement routing through the AMM/vault/loan-broker account and intermediary before exchange deposit.
supporting: Bithomp labels rJqi as Ripple and displays 183M transfers to raRVLN.
raRVLN forwards XRP to unlabelled r39TA; r39TA deposits 68.9246M to Binance-labelled rNxp4h.
disconfirming: Six Binance deposits predate the separate 20M receipt at 20:16.

hypotheses.claim: Market-maker inventory rebalancing through an AMM pool followed by exchange deposit.
supporting: AMM classification and exchange-tagged deposits are consistent with rebalancing.
disconfirming: No market maker, customer or execution identified.

supporting: XRPLWin classification and concurrent XRP/RLUSD movements.
disconfirming: No vault ID, loan record or collateral posting resolved.

hypotheses.claim: Unrelated user, pool and exchange movements with no common institutional controller.
supporting: No owner mapping; AMM is shared liquidity; 20M receipt is later than deposits.
disconfirming: Repeated large transfers form a coherent account-level sequence.

hypotheses.claim: 68.9246M deposits represent Binance's post-incident replenishment purchases.
supporting: Binance announced aggregate replenishment; Binance-labelled account received XRP.
disconfirming: No XRP-specific allocation, source ownership, execution or reserve accounting.

limitations: r39TA account overview and transaction history are not synchronized; no missing outgoing payment is inferred.
The account-level path through an AMM/vault/loan-broker does not establish same-unit provenance, beneficial ownership, sale or Binance replenishment.
next_actions: Run exact-head archive validator and fail-closed gate.
Crosswalk five compromised source wallets against official PoR address data.
Monitor r39TA, raRVLN, rNxp4h and attacker receiver.
Keep observations out of model features until synchronized, corroborated and leakage-safe.
